mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods(barcode, name, wholesale_price, retail_price, vendor_id) VALUES(#{barcode}, #{name}, #{wholesalePrice}, #{retailPrice}, #{vendorId})
mapper.select: SELECT g.*, f.name AS vendor_name FROM goods g LEFT JOIN factory f ON g.vendor_id = f.id WHERE g.barcode = #{barcode}
